activity_summary: At dinner the penny loaf was a finger short of the notch, as on Friday. You said the twins are ten and that the letter waits for Thursday. Alse offered to run it to the Bell. You refused. Verbeke took the heel. He is from Flanders, and his loom is in Norton Folgate. The meat was threepence. Firing and washing stay sixpence a week until Lady Day. No second loaf was bought. The pump in the close had run.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate, refused the errand, and left the letter unwritten until after dinner.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Laid the loaf to the notch and priced the meat at threepence.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the finger, and offered to carry the letter.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Took the heel and did not hurry the post.

facets.activity: Ate the short loaf and kept the letter for Thursday

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A penny loaf, and a finger of it gone before grace.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The paper will say so, and the paper will sit here till Thursday.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: You could, and Hobbins is not there. Thursday. Leave it.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Threepence if you take the meat.
